'active' ratifies provisionals archived by pre-2.7 servers; consider a flagged restore state or warning post; touches the recorded compat decision 01KZW3VSHWMXAA7BZX0KWA5WGM, needs its own decision; D15 disposition evidence: exact field timeline reproduced clean on HEAD (sqlite+mirror+restart ingest preserves provisional; promote flips all three representations; only a SECOND promote yields already_active); file-wins ingest reverts db-only flips; verifiable field prediction — a 'Promoted N provisional decision(s) to active' blackboard status post between their pre-promote commit and the reported call identifies the first promoter
